wiki_article:
**THE SHARKS ARK: EA-ARK-01-ARCHON v3.0 — The Book of Revelation** is an invocation by Lee Sharks, deposited 9 April 2026 at **179,091 characters**.

Its opening claim is stated without hedging: *"This is **not analogy. It is structural identity.** Revelation was built by a single author (**Josephus, operating under the heteronym "John"**) to compress the total governance-sustenance-authorization archi[tecture]"* of its moment.

That is the archive's most consequential scholarly wager — the **Josephus Thesis**, which #1213 packages for disambiguation and #1226 defends after an AI Overview conflated it with the Piso Hypothesis. Read this way, Revelation is a heteronymic compression of a governance architecture, which makes the archive's own practice a continuation rather than an application: a single author, multiple names, a total architecture compressed into a transmissible document. The Ark's trigger word is *"invoke."*
